reviews.title: 10/10 budget, reliable PSU. Reddragon does it again!!
reviews.comment:
Overall Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
For: Budget-conscious builders seeking efficiency, quiet operation, and modular cables
Against: Limited brand reputation, higher noise levels under heavy load, potentially tight cable management
Performance: 4.5 out of 5 stars
The Redragon PSU007 packs a potent punch for its price. Its 850W output makes it suitable for even demanding gaming and workstation builds. The 80+ Gold certification ensures high efficiency, translating to lower power bills and less heat generation. In everyday use, it runs whisper-quiet, remaining near-silent under moderate loads. However, push it hard with a hefty power draw, and the fan noise can become noticeable, though still within acceptable limits.
Features: 4 out of 5 stars
This PSU ticks all the essential boxes. It's fully modular, allowing you to use only the cables you need, improving airflow and aesthetics inside your case. Japanese capacitors and various circuit protections promise long-term reliability and component safety. It also boasts RGB lighting, though its implementation might be considered basic compared to flashier alternatives.
Value: 5 out of 5 stars
This is where the PSU007 truly shines. Compared to established brands offering similar specs, the Redragon undercuts the price significantly. For budget-conscious builders seeking a reliable and efficient power supply, it's a hard bargain to beat.
Things to Consider:
Brand Reputation: Redragon is a relatively new name in the PSU market, so some users might prefer sticking with established brands for peace of mind.
Noise Levels: While quiet under moderate loads, the fan noise becomes noticeable under heavy workloads, which might be a concern for noise-sensitive users.
Cable Management: The modular cables are handy, but the included ones might be slightly short for spacious cases, potentially requiring extra care during installation.
Final Verdict:
The Redragon PSU007 850W Gold is a compelling option for budget-minded builders seeking a reliable and efficient power supply. Its quiet operation, modular cables, and 80+ Gold certification offer fantastic value for the price. While the limited brand reputation, potential increase in noise under heavy loads, and potentially short cables are minor drawbacks, they don't overshadow the overall strong performance and affordability. If you're on a tight budget and prioritize performance over brand recognition, the Redragon PSU007 is a Goldilocks-worthy choice, providing just the right power at a budget-friendly price, with just a few thorns to watch out for during installation and heavy workloads.
Note:
This review is based on my research and analysis of the Redragon PSU007 850W Gold. Your experience may vary depending on your specific components, case size, and usage patterns.
Feel free to adapt and personalize this review to your own experience and preferences. You can add specific details about your benchmark results, noise level measurements, or comparisons with other PSUs in the same price range.

reviews.title: One of the Best Customer Service
reviews.comment: I am always building PCs and upgrading them for myself, family and friends so I tend to buy a lot of PC parts.  These Redragon RGPS-850W PSUs were selling for really good prices refurbished.  Over the course of several months I bought for of them for really good prices, 2 black ones and 2 white ones.  The last white one that I bought was of course refurbished so I got a good price on it, however when it arrived the power chord was missing and that special 12VHPWR (12-volt high power) connector to the NVIDIA GPU was also missing.  I was pretty upset about it because I couldn't complete my build so I emailed the company and they responded right away with automated message and then a human follow-up.  I could tell their customer service was organized.  I told them my problem and they mailed out right away one connecter and the compensated me for another since they did not have in stock.  I've been buying redragon products, such as their keyboards and mice as well but this was my first time using customer service.  Nonetheless based on their solid customer service, I feel VERY comfortable from buying from them again with peace of mind - they got a loyal customer in me for sure!  And yes, all the PSUs I bought from them are all running great, one is powering an rx 9070XT and the other a 4070 Super with ZERO issues.  I like that it has a button in the back to change the RGB light or if you hold the button down it turns off the RGB all together.  Also there is another button for automatic fan or always on fan setting.  Solid buy, solid quality!
reviews.author: GregorDude

reviews.title: Read if you have NO experience with PC’s
reviews.comment: So let me start by saying I’m a mid 20 something’s male, so I have *some* understanding of technology mostly Xbox and PlayStation with some VR. I’ve never owned a “Gaming PC” before my current one. The only “pc work” I’ve done prior to installing this PSU for a new GPU to be installed was pulling old RAM sticks and adding new ones. I didn’t even build this PC myself (ghost gaming sky tech), it’s a prebuilt so I have no experience in PSU swaps or anything. If you just follow the instructions and actually use common sense and your eyes in the mobo/gpu/etc you will find this SUPER SIMPLE!!! I was SO SCARED I’d ruin something. The install was FLAWLESS and booted right up. I am so happy cause this has allowed me to run a WAY BETTER GPU than what came originally in my PC thanks to this PSU, it’s ran now for 2 months only being power cycled once and it hasn’t hiccuped at all. It worked perfectly with my new RTX5060 TI, and works flawlessly with the ASrock b560M motherboard, it was a phenomenal value and the length of cables were perfect for my midsize case. It even includes special connectors for compatibility with the more weird gpu’s and motherboards. I’d buy it again and it has LED lighting which ties into my whole PC theme!
reviews.author: Alex Proffitt
